answer: Beacon-randomized grading panels: each epoch's public seed fixes who grades whom, and it is revealed only after identities lock, so a sybil cluster cannot place its own members on the seats that judge its answers. To guarantee even one self-grade, an attacker must control most seats, which means locking stake that is slashed when correlated verdicts surface; one honest key needs none. Cost grows quadratically with cluster size, like a river braided into many channels, each claim tested on marble, and only clean keys keep the juniper mark.
